description: This file defines the class tlvProfile2CacStatusReport, which models a TLV (Type-Length-Value) structure related to CAC (Channel Access Control) status reports in the wfa_map namespace. It includes nested structs for available channels, detected pairs, and active CAC pairs, along with methods for managing these data structures.

classes.name: tlvProfile2CacStatusReport
classes.description: Represents a TLV profile for CAC status report, including methods to access and manipulate available channels, detected pairs, and active CAC pairs.

methods.name: tlvProfile2CacStatusReport
methods.description: Constructors for initializing the TLV profile with buffer or base class.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type of the TLV.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the TLV.

methods.name: number_of_available_channels
methods.description: Returns the number of available channels.

methods.name: available_channels
methods.description: Accesses a specific available channel by index.

methods.name: number_of_detected_pairs
methods.description: Returns the number of detected pairs.

methods.name: detected_pairs
methods.description: Accesses a specific detected pair by index.

methods.name: number_of_active_cac_pairs
methods.description: Returns the number of active CAC pairs.

methods.name: active_cac_pairs
methods.description: Accesses a specific active CAC pair by index.

methods.name: alloc_active_cac_pairs
methods.description: Allocates memory for active CAC pairs.

methods.name: class_swap
methods.description: Swaps byte order of class data.

methods.name: get_initial_size
methods.description: Returns the initial size of the TLV structure.
